_about: Questions for the query parser (M3-4) and the filters Python must build from the model's reply. The first 11 are the retrieval eval questions (evals/retrieval.jsonl); the rest test filters the eval set doesn't. Sizes of screws, discs or plates are never a height. responses.json holds the model's reply for each question.
